gloss: a little while ago, just now

definitions.gloss: a little while ago, just now, a moment ago
definitions.explanation: Refers to a short time in the recent past, typically within the same day or conversation.

examples.japanese: {先程|さきほど}{電話|でんわ}がありました。
examples.english: There was a phone call a little while ago.

examples.japanese: {先程|さきほど}お{話|はな}しした{件|けん}ですが。
examples.english: Regarding the matter we discussed earlier.

examples.japanese: {先程|さきほど}は{失礼|しつれい}しました。

notes:
REGISTER: Polite and formal. Commonly used in business and formal contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・さっき - a little while ago (casual)
・{先|さき}ほど - a little while ago (polite)
・ついさっき - just a moment ago (casual)

USAGE: 先程 is the polite form of さっき.
